accepted_plan.summary: Accept Panel startup latency E2E measurement/improvement work. Measure first visible render via real yoi PTY E2E, separate background/full-ready waits, improve startup path where safe, and record before/after evidence.
accepted_plan.role_plan: Orchestrator creates dedicated implementation worktree and spawns Coder with write scope limited to that worktree. Reviewer will run read-only after implementation report. Can run in parallel with Plugin resolver work because source surfaces are disjoint.
